evidence_articles.title: Congress promises ₹72,000 per annum to poorest people
evidence_articles.rephrased: The article covers Rahul Gandhi's announcement of the NYAY minimum income guarantee scheme, which promises to directly transfer ₹72,000 per year to the bank accounts of India's poorest 20% families.
evidence_articles.content: Congress president Rahul Gandhi on Monday announced a minimum income guarantee scheme, Nyuntam Aay Yojana (NYAY), under which ₹72,000 a year will be transferred to the bank accounts of 20% of the poorest families in the country if his party is voted to power.

recent_articles.title: Assam Cabinet expansion: Several new faces, no room for high-profile Congress defectors | India News - The Indian Express
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Sarma**'s cabinet has expanded to 17 ministers, with 12 of them from his first term.  The new additions include **Biswajit Daimary**, the Speaker of the previous assembly and a Bodo leader; **Nilima Devi**, president of the Assam Pradesh BJP Mahila Morcha; and **Ashwini Roy Sarkar** and **Sushanta Borgohain**. Notably, no high-profile Congress leaders who joined the BJP before the election have been included. The expansion leaves room for two more ministers in future.

recent_articles.title: Who Is Gangadhara Ajjayya? The Saint In Whose Name DK Shivakumar Took Oath As Karnataka Chief Minister
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **DK Shivakumar**, the newly sworn-in Chief Minister of Karnataka, invoked **Veera Gangadhara Ajjaya**, a revered saint from Nonavinakere's Shri Kadasiddeshwara Mutt, during his oath ceremony. The mutt is known for its unique system where devotees seek answers through a sacred linga and chalk-written messages.  Ajjayya's spiritual guidance has been influential in Shivakumar's life, with the Chief Minister visiting the mutt throughout his political career, seeking advice during periods of uncertainty and celebrating victories. The significance of this relationship extends beyond politics, as the Nonavinakere Mutt is a respected institution within Karnataka's religious landscape.

recent_articles.title: Bhupinder Hooda's Remark Fuels Buzz Of Amarinder Singh's Congress Crossover
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Captain Amarinder Singh** is reportedly in contact with **Congress** leaders ahead of the Punjab elections next year, according to former Haryana chief minister **Bhupinder Hooda**.  **Hooda** described **Amarinder** as a senior Congress leader and long-time associate. **Amarinder**, who joined the BJP in 2021 after leaving the Congress, has expressed discomfort with the party's functioning and leadership style, citing a lack of personal outreach from leaders compared to the Congress.  While some senior Punjab Congress leaders have indicated that **Amarinder** would be welcomed back if he chooses to return, the BJP has dismissed the speculation as mere communication without political negotiations.

recent_articles.title: A Lok Sabha Problem Awaits Mamata Banerjee? Humanyun Kabir's Big Claim
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Humayun Kabir**, expelled leader of the Trinamool Congress, claims that 20 MPs within the party are planning to remove **Abhishek Banerjee** as the leader of the party in the Lok Sabha.  Kabir, who heads his own party Aam Janata Unnayan Party (AJUP), stated that these MPs have spoken to the Speaker about this potential removal and that a split within the Trinamool is likely. The current internal conflict within the party stems from disagreements over leadership positions, with some MLAs supporting **Ritabrata Banerjee** instead of **Mamata Banerjee's** chosen candidate for the state assembly leader of opposition position.

recent_articles.title: Plague On Both Your Houses: Bengal Minister On Divided Trinamool
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Swapan Dasgupta**, a senior Bengal BJP leader, advised against supporting **Trinamool Congress** rebels, stating that the people's mandate for a "complete detoxification process" should be allowed to unfold. He believes the BJP should not intervene in the internal divisions within the party and instead focus on fulfilling its mandate of providing good governance to West Bengal. Dasgupta criticized both factions of the **Trinamool Congress**, suggesting that neither is deserving of support, as they are plagued by corruption and lack of integrity.

recent_articles.title: Watch: TMC crisis: loyalists back Mamata, rebels stand firm | Above the Fold | 04.06.2026 - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Trinamool Congress** internal divisions and the **U.S. House of Representatives** vote on the Iran war are among the top news stories today.  The latest developments in the deadly Delhi fire tragedy also received coverage.

recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Trinamool Congress** internal divisions, the **U.S. House of Representatives** vote on the Iran war, and the ongoing Delhi fire tragedy are among the top news stories today.  The **Above the Fold** program features coverage from **Naveenkumar V**, **Karthi P**, and **Ragavi M**.

recent_articles.title: How Mamata Banerjee Created Trinamool After Breaking Away From Congress
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Mamata Banerjee's** Trinamool Congress is experiencing internal dissent, with a faction led by Ritobrata Bandopadhyay challenging the party's organizational structure and power dynamics.  This group criticizes the current leadership, particularly Abhishek Banerjee, and seeks to create a separate political space within Bengal politics. The dissidents are focused on legislative control and ideological legitimacy, raising questions about whether they will demand formal recognition or remain a pressure group. Whether this internal conflict leads to another major split in the party remains uncertain.

recent_articles.title: "Ideology With Which Party Was Formed Does Not Exist": Expelled Trinamool MLA Sandipan Saha
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Trinamool Congress (TMC)** expelled MLA Sandipan Saha claims that 58 rebel MLAs elected **Ritabrata Banerjee** as Leader of Opposition after signing an attendance register which was later presented as a resolution, alleging forgery.  The rebellion has plunged the party into its gravest internal crisis since its inception, with the rebels securing recognition from the Assembly Speaker and forming their own leadership structure. Saha claims that he and other dissidents were silenced within the party and forced to raise concerns through social media.

recent_articles.title: Centre Preps Delimitation Push, Eyes New Bill Before 2029 Elections
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **The Centre** is seeking political consensus to introduce a new delimitation bill before the 2029 Lok Sabha elections. The move aims to redraw parliamentary constituencies, potentially altering representation among states and addressing concerns raised by regions with controlled population growth. **Regional parties**, including the DMK and Trinamool Congress, are being consulted as part of this process.  The government is aiming for a consensus-driven approach to avoid political divisiveness while ensuring fair representation.

recent_articles.title: Trinamool Congress Rebels Play In Midfield As They Seek Mamata Banerjee's Advice
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Ritabrata Bandopadhyay**, a key figure in the dissident camp within the **Trinamool Congress**, stated that they want **Mamata Banerjee** to remain as an advisor to their opposition group. The dissidents are not directly opposing **Banerjee**, but instead criticize the increasing influence of **Abhishek Banerjee**, IPAC-style political management, and the corporatisation of the party. They aim to project themselves as a separate faction within the Trinamool while maintaining respect for **Banerjee**'s leadership. The dissidents argue that they are seeking advice from **Banerjee** and want to eliminate **Abhishek Banerjee** from the opposition leadership.  The group believes this is an internal struggle for the "opposition space" in Bengal politics, which they believe has been neglected by the Trinamool party.

recent_articles.title: OpenAI and Anthropic Sign Letter to Prevent AI-Developed Biological Weapons | WIRED
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Google DeepMind**, **OpenAI**, **Anthropic**, and **Microsoft AI** CEOs, along with other scientists and experts, are urging Congress to enact new laws requiring gene synthesis companies to screen customers and orders for potential misuse of genetic material. The letter, organized by the Institute for Progress and the Foundation for American Innovation, acknowledges the rapid pace of AI development and its potential impact on bioweapons development.  The signatories highlight concerns about the ease with which dangerous pathogens could be designed using AI tools while emphasizing the need for stricter regulations to prevent misuse.

recent_articles.title: West Bengal Trinamool Chaos: Has Mamata Banerjee Reached Her Political Endgame?
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The Trinamool Congress (TMC) is facing a severe internal crisis following its loss in the recent West Bengal Assembly elections.  **Mamata Banerjee**, despite retaining her personal appeal, faces a fractured party with 58 MLAs supporting expelled leader **Ritabrata Banerjee** as Leader of the Opposition. The party's organizational structure has been significantly weakened by allegations of centralized control and corporate-style management. **Abhishek Banerjee**, Mamata's nephew and national general secretary, is facing criticism for his leadership style, further exacerbating the internal conflict.  The TMC's future hinges on whether **Mamata Banerjee** can address these issues and rebuild the party from the grassroots level or if it will fragment into irrelevance.

recent_articles.title: CBI To Probe Death Of Ex-Kerala OfficialNaveen Babu, Daughter To Get Government Job
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Kerala** government has decided to hand over the investigation into the death of former Kannur Additional District Magistrate Naveen Babu to the **Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI)**. The decision follows family demands for a central agency inquiry and concerns about unanswered questions surrounding his death, which occurred on August 15, 2024.  The government also decided to provide a compassionate appointment to Naveen Babu's daughter, Niranjana.

recent_articles.title: TMC councillor of Kolkata Municipal Corporation arrested for ‘molesting’ woman - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Biswajit Mondal**, a **Trinamool Congress** (TMC) councillor of Kolkata Municipal Corporation Ward No. 114, was arrested on June 4, 2026, for allegedly assaulting and molesting a woman in March 2024. The arrest follows a complaint filed by the woman at Regent Park police station, who also alleged verbal abuse and threats from Mondal after the change of government in West Bengal last month. This incident comes amidst a wave of arrests targeting TMC leaders and elected representatives across the state for various allegations including extortion, intimidation, and corruption.

recent_articles.title: "Party Bigger Than Positions": Karnataka Congress Chief B.K. Hariprasad Amid Cabinet Buzz
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **B.K. Hariprasad**, newly appointed **KPCC** president, emphasized the importance of prioritizing party strength and democratic values over power in leading the Karnataka Congress. He acknowledged concerns about women's representation in the cabinet and assured that it would be addressed during the next expansion.  He also stressed the need to strengthen the party's commitment to inclusivity and social balance, contrasting it with the BJP's single-leader ideology. **Hariprasad** expressed confidence in **D.K. Shivakumar**, the new chief minister, stating that he is capable of leading effectively despite challenges.

recent_articles.title: Aditya Shah favors domestic growth themes, stays bullish on IT and infrastructure sector - The Economic Times
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Shah**, a prominent investor, advises focusing on **EPC contractors**, road contractors, and established players like **L&T** in the infrastructure sector due to strong order books. He remains constructive on the IT sector despite AI concerns, highlighting companies like **TCS** and **HCL Tech**.  He suggests evaluating opportunities on a company-by-company basis rather than broad sector bets. While optimistic about India's cell manufacturing potential, he cautions about Ola Electric's customer support issues and advises waiting for further evidence of improvement before investing. He prefers domestic growth themes like chemicals, infrastructure, banks, and financials over metal stocks due to easing valuations. Despite challenges in the airline industry, **Shah** remains positive on IndiGo's dominant market position and expects near-term earnings pressure but continued market share gains.  He believes any resulting market correction presents an opportunity for long-term investors.

recent_articles.title: Exclusive | Is the India story over for FIIs? BofA says investors don't want to miss what's next - The Economic Times
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Investors** are cautiously optimistic about India's economic prospects, acknowledging the cyclical nature of the market. While Q4 earnings showed a marginal beat, overall growth remains muted due to commodity-driven earnings and concerns over inflation. **FIIs** have been pulling out capital, citing alternatives in other markets and India's weak performance.  The **Indian government** needs to address energy security, fiscal consolidation, and regulatory reforms to attract foreign investment and boost investor confidence.

recent_articles.title: Tamil Nadu Chief Minister Vijay Allocates Lone Rajya Sabha Seat To Congress
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Chief Minister Vijay** of Tamil Nadu has allotted the vacant Rajya Sabha seat to the **Congress**, a move seen as strengthening the alliance between the two parties.  The decision is crucial for the stability of the minority TVK government, which relies on the five Congress MLAs for support. The announcement comes after senior Congress leader and Tamil Nadu in-charge Girish Chodankar met Vijay, fueling speculation that **Congress strategist Praveen Chakravarty** could be nominated. While the move has been welcomed by the Congress, the DMK has criticized it as an attempt to avoid a direct confrontation with the BJP.

recent_articles.title: Kerala faces burden of ₹5.07-lakh crore liabilities; fiscal structure under ‘serious’ strain, says White Paper tabled by CM - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Chief Minister V.D. Satheesan** tabled a white paper in the State Assembly on Thursday, June 4, 2026, highlighting Kerala's fiscal strain. The document states that the state faces a large burden of outstanding liabilities and high interest payments, while its capital expenditure is among the lowest in India despite a high fiscal deficit.  The white paper also points to "parallel governance structures" like the **Kerala Infrastructure Investment Fund Board (KIIFB)** as contributing to the fiscal stress.

recent_articles.title: B K Hariprasad is new Karnataka Congress chief | Bangalore News - The Indian Express
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **The AICC** appointed **B K Hariprasad**, a senior Congress leader and four-time Rajya Sabha MP, as the new president of the Karnataka state unit.  Hariprasad, an OBC leader from the Billava community, is known for his association with the Gandhi family and his criticism of the RSS. His appointment is seen as a counter to **D K Shivakumar**, who has adopted a "soft Hindutva" approach.

recent_articles.title: NHRC takes cognisance of Express report on 53 maternal deaths in MP’s Sidhi, issues notice | India News - The Indian Express
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **National Human Rights Commission (NHRC)** has taken notice of a report by The Indian Express detailing 53 maternal deaths in Madhya Pradesh's Sidhi district between April 2025 and March 2026.  **The NHRC** issued a notice to the state Chief Secretary, demanding a detailed report within two weeks. **Congress** leader Umang Singhar called for a review of maternal health services across the state, while BJP spokesperson Hitesh Bajpai acknowledged progress but highlighted challenges in remote areas.

recent_articles.title: Who Is Firhad Hakim, Close Mamata Banerjee Aide Who Quit As Kolkata Mayor
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Mamata Banerjee** faced a major split within her **Trinamool Congress**, with 59 of 80 MLAs supporting rebel leader Ritabrata Banerjee.  The party also saw the resignation of Firhad Hakim as Kolkata Mayor after around 100 councillors deserted the party.  Hakim had previously offered his resignation but was initially refused by **Mamata Banerjee**. Senior Trinamool leader Kunal Ghosh confirmed that Hakim's decision to resign was made with dignity and that **Mamata Banerjee** eventually agreed to it. The split comes after an administrative meeting at the state secretariat Nabanna, where several Trinamool MLAs attended, including Hakim.

recent_articles.title: TMC fault lines in the open: 58 of 80 MLAs back rebel as Leader of Opposition | Kolkata News - The Indian Express
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Atri Mitra**, a highly experienced **Special Correspondent** for **The Indian Express**, brings over two decades of reporting experience to his coverage of administration and political news in Eastern and North-Eastern India.  His expertise is particularly focused on West Bengal, where he has dedicated more than ten years to covering political developments. **Ravik Bhattacharya**, the Chief of Bureau of **The Indian Express**, Kolkata, boasts over 20 years of experience in journalism and specializes in politics, crime, major incidents, and investigative stories across various regions including West Bengal, Odisha, Assam, and the Andaman Nicobar Islands.  **Bhattacharya** has a long and distinguished career with notable awards, including the Ramnath Goenka Excellence in Journalism Award for Political Reporting in 2007.

recent_articles.title: Iran War: Donald Trump Faces Setback As US House Passes War Powers Resolution To End Iran War
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The US House of Representatives passed a resolution urging the withdrawal of American troops from the Iran war, a largely symbolic move that delivered a political blow to President Donald Trump. The measure, which passed 215-208, heads to the Senate but would face a presidential veto.  **Democrats** view this as a potential turning point in their efforts to reassert Congress's role in decisions of war and peace. While Republicans who support **Trump** argue that the resolution weakens the US, they are facing growing political pressure ahead of November's midterm elections.

recent_articles.title: Amid broken ties, Rahul, Kharge hail Karunanidhi on his birth anniversary - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Congress** president Mallikarjun Kharge and **Rahul Gandhi** paid tributes to former Tamil Nadu Chief Minister **Muthuvel Karunanidhi**, fondly known as "Kalaignar," on his birthday.  Kharge praised **Karunanidhi's** lifelong commitment to social justice and democratic values, while Gandhi highlighted his dedication to the dignity of the Tamil people. The tributes are seen as an attempt to mend strained ties between the Congress and the DMK following the party's alliance with actor-turned politician Vijay's Tamilaga Vettri Kazhagam (TVK).

recent_articles.title: Calcutta High Court to hear Abhishek’s plea seeking protection - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Abhishek Banerjee**, general secretary of the **Trinamool Congress**, was granted permission by the Calcutta High Court to file a petition seeking protection against coercive action from the West Bengal CID. The court is expected to hear the matter later this week.  The legal team representing Mr. Banerjee argued that he had no connection to the case, while Enforcement Directorate officials served him with a notice for questioning in the primary teacher recruitment scam. Two Trinamool MLAs filed a complaint alleging forged signatures on a letter declaring **Sobhandeb Chattopadhyay** as the party's choice for Leader of Opposition (LoP), leading to an FIR and summons against Mr. Banerjee. The controversy has caused a split within the party, with at least 58 MLAs forming a new opposition group.

recent_articles.title: Congress Rahul Gandhi Priyanka Gandhi: With Eye On Upcoming Polls, Congress Plans Major Organisational Reshuffle
recent_articles.rephrased_article: Following the appointment of DK Shivakumar as Chief Minister of Karnataka, **BK Hariprasad** has been named the state Congress president.  The Congress is planning a major reshuffle across over six states, with a focus on poll-bound regions like Uttar Pradesh, Uttarakhand, Punjab, Goa, Manipur, Gujarat, and Himachal Pradesh. The party is considering replacing in-charges and state presidents to attract voters and balance caste dynamics. This reshuffle is expected to be the last major one under **Mallikarjun Kharge**'s leadership as Congress president.

recent_articles.title: ‘Unauthorised’ school in Chunabhatti ordered shut, students told to relocate | Mumbai News - The Indian Express
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Parents** of students at **Orchids International School** in Mumbai's Chunabhatti were surprised to be asked to relocate their children to other branches after the school was declared unauthorized for operating without government permission. The **school** management has been informed about the unauthorized status since March 2026, and a fine of Rs 1,00,000 has been levied. Parents argue that they were misled by the school's assurances that the situation would be resolved before classes began.  The **school** claims to have issued new information to parents about the expected final approval for operations at the Chunabhatti location by July.

recent_articles.title: 36 arrests in a day as Kochi City police launch ‘Operation Toofan’ - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Kochi City police** conducted a series of raids as part of the "Operation Toofan: The Narco Hunt" initiative, resulting in 33 NDPS Act cases and 36 arrests across 90 locations.  The largest seizure involved 437.28 grams of suspected MDMA found at Kollamkudi Mugal near Thrikkakara. **Assistant Commissioner of Police (Narcotics Cell) T.D. Sunilkumar** led the District Anti-Narcotics Special Action Force, which also includes teams from various police stations.  The operation was launched by Chief Minister V.D. Satheesan and overseen by **Inspector General (Intelligence) Putta Vimaladitya**, who serves as the State nodal officer for the project.

recent_articles.title: BK Hariprasad Replaces DK Shivakumar As Karnataka Congress Chief
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **B.K. Hariprasad**, a veteran Congress leader, has been appointed as the new President of the **Karnataka Pradesh Congress Committee (KPCC)** by **AICC President Mallikarjun Kharge**.  He replaces **D.K. Shivakumar**, who resigned from the position after six years in charge and contributed to the party's victory in 2023.  Hariprasad, known for his criticism of Hindutva organizations and the BJP, is a former Member of the Rajya Sabha and has served as a Member of the Karnataka Legislative Council.

recent_articles.title: Trouble mounts for TMC MP: CID notice pending, ED summons Abhishek Banerjee in teacher recruitment scam | Kolkata News - The Indian Express
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Abhishek Banerjee**, nephew of former Chief Minister **Mamata Banerjee**, was summoned by the **Enforcement Directorate (ED)** to appear before it on June 15 in connection with the teacher recruitment irregularities case. The ED found evidence linking money from the scam to his company, Leaps and Bounds Pvt Ltd.  The **CID** had also issued a notice to **Abhishek Banerjee** for questioning on June 1 regarding a signature forgery case filed by two TMC MLAs who alleged fabricated resolutions.

recent_articles.title: Govt. to directly purchase land in Ayyankuzhi for waste management project - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **The Kerala government**, in collaboration with the **World Bank** and its **Kerala Solid Waste Management Project (KSWMP)**, will acquire land at Ayyankuzhi near Ambalamugal for the rehabilitation of families affected by industrial pollution. The acquisition will be funded through KSWMP funds and will involve direct purchase from landowners to expedite project completion and minimize litigation.  The government will decide on the specific waste treatment facility to be built on the 9.4-acre site, which was initially proposed as a sanitary land filling but has since been put on hold.

recent_articles.title: Exclusive With DK Shivakumar's Daughter, Brother After Big Karnataka Oath
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **DK Shivakumar**, the newly sworn-in Chief Minister of Karnataka, faces high expectations from his family and the public. **Rahul Gandhi** urged focus on upcoming elections in 2028 and 2029, while Shivakumar's daughter Aisshwarya DKS Hegde emphasized a commitment to returning to power in future elections.  Shivakumar has already initiated plans for Bengaluru infrastructure improvements, building regularization, and free student bus rides.

recent_articles.title: Pseudo-police gang that kidnapped businessman and extorted ₹5.26 lakh busted in Cyberabad - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Cyberabad police** arrested five members of a pseudo-police gang who allegedly kidnapped a businessman, impersonated police officers, and extorted over ₹5 lakh from him. The suspects, identified as Nagaraju Raghu Varma, Yeswanth Singh alias Rahul, Sathyabhan Singh alias Thakur, Thangellapalli Nagendra Varma, and two others still at large, were apprehended following an investigation into the incident reported by a 42-year-old businessman in Kukatpally. The gang used fake police uniforms, forged identity cards, and other tactics to deceive their victims before withdrawing money from his bank accounts and assaulting him.  Police are continuing to investigate and identify additional victims.

recent_articles.title: TMC leader Jay Prakash Majumdar held over ‘grabbing’ woman’s house | Kolkata News - The Indian Express
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Jay Prakash Majumdar**, a **TMC** leader, was arrested by the police in connection with allegedly illegally occupying a woman's house for several years and harassing her.  The arrest followed a protest against Majumdar outside his flat in Bidhannagar, where he allegedly assaulted some protesters. Meanwhile, Kolkata Police arrested Ward No 42 Councilor **Mahesh Kumar Sharma** on Wednesday in connection with a case filed in 2025.

recent_articles.title: How Pune IT firm duped nearly 700 techies before vanishing | Pune News - The Indian Express
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **ThynkTech India OPC Pvt Ltd**, a tech start-up that recruited hundreds of engineering graduates across Maharashtra, abruptly shut down its Hinjewadi office in Pune. The company's CEO, Harshal Thakre, disappeared and failed to pay rent, maintenance charges, and electricity bills, leading to the sealing of the office.  **ThynkTech India** promised internships and job opportunities with a monthly stipend and a confirmed salary upon completion of training. However, interns were left without laptops, training, or compensation after discovering that the company was not legitimate. **ThynkTech India** has been accused of fraud by affected interns who are demanding action against the CEO and the clearing of all outstanding payments.

recent_articles.title: D K Shivakumar sworn in as 24th state CM, ex-CM Siddaramaiah’s son gets cabinet berth | Bangalore News - The Indian Express
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **D K Shivakumar**, the newly elected leader of the **Congress Legislature Party (CLP)** in Karnataka, was sworn in as the state's 24th chief minister alongside a 13-person cabinet. The ceremony, attended by Congress top brass, CMs of three states, and outgoing CM Siddaramaiah, took place on Wednesday at Lok Bhavan.  Shivakumar, who ascended to the position after leading the Congress to victory in the 2023 state elections, emphasized his commitment to youth leadership and a new era for Karnataka. The cabinet, largely composed of members from the previous Siddaramaiah administration, reflects the Congress's efforts to maintain its caste base while balancing power dynamics.

recent_articles.title: DK Shivakumar Comes With Mastery Of Delhi Networks And Karnataka Grassroots
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **DK Shivakumar**, a seasoned politician, has been appointed the Chief Minister of Karnataka.  He has consistently demonstrated his political acumen and organizational skills throughout his career, navigating complex power dynamics within the Congress party. **Shivakumar**'s ascent to the top position is attributed to his mastery of grassroots electoral math in his home constituency and his ability to build strong networks in Delhi's high-power circles. He skillfully managed a smooth transition of power with **Siddaramaiah**, ensuring a peaceful handover despite persistent speculation about his own ambition for the Chief Minister's role.

recent_articles.title: Mamata Banerjee, Abhishek Banerjee, Leader of Opposition, Ritabrata Banerjee, Sandipan Saha - "Real" Trinamool Backs Rebel For Key Post, Says 'Mamata Banerjee Our Leader'
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Trinamool Congress** MLA Ritabrata Banerjee claims to have the support of 59 MLAs, aiming to challenge **Mamata Banerjee's** nominee for Leader of Opposition, **Sobhandeb Chattopadhyay**.  Banerjee alleges forged signatures on a letter supporting Chattopadhyay. The Assembly Secretariat has filed a police case into the matter, with the CID investigating. Chief Minister **Suvendu Adhikari** stated that three Trinamool MLAs confessed to not signing the document.

recent_articles.title: Fund crunch paralyses cultural academies in Kerala - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Kerala**'s premier cultural academies are facing a severe financial crisis, leading to salary delays and administrative disruptions. **The Kerala Sahitya Akademi** and **Kerala Sangeetha Nataka Akademi** have been unable to pay salaries due to delayed government funding. The situation is further complicated by the absence of governing bodies following a change in government, hindering decision-making and financial transactions. Cultural organization Samskara Sahithi has called for an inquiry into alleged misuse of funds and demanded new governing bodies and a 'cultural White Paper'.

recent_articles.title: D.K. Shivakumar sworn-in as 25th Chief Minister of Karnataka - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **D.K. Shivakumar**, the newly elected **Chief Minister of Karnataka**, was sworn in on Wednesday, June 3, 2026, alongside **G. Parameshwara** as Deputy Chief Minister.  The swearing-in ceremony took place at Glass House in Lok Bhavan and saw the inclusion of 13 Cabinet ministers, with a focus on senior party members. The event was attended by prominent figures from across the political spectrum, including Rahul Gandhi and Sukhvinder Singh Sukhu. Shivakumar's administration will face challenges as it navigates the upcoming Rajya Sabha and Karnataka Legislative Council elections.

recent_articles.title: Open to dialogue with Govt, Opposition; CBSE transfers ‘eyewash’: Cockroach Janata Party holds first press conference - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Cockroach Janata Party (CJP)**, led by Abhijeet Dipke, announced its readiness for dialogue with the government and opposition over demands related to Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan's resignation following the NEET and CBSE fiasco. The party plans a protest on June 6th at Jantar Mantar, demanding accountability in the system.  **Saurav Das**, CJP spokesperson, criticized the government's recent transfers of **Rahul Singh** and **Himanshu Gupta**, calling them "eyewash."  The party also expressed concern about potential police action against founder **Dipke** and climate activist **Sonam Wangchuk**.

recent_articles.title: How the D-day unfolded for DKS, reaching across political divide - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **D.K. Shivakumar**, the newly sworn-in Chief Minister of Karnataka, began his day with personal and political gestures, including calls to MLAs and a visit to former Chief Ministers **B.S. Yediyurappa** and **H.D. Deve Gowda**. He chose traditional attire for his oath ceremony and invited Congress leaders **Rahul Gandhi**, **Mallikarjun Kharge**, and **Sonia Gandhi** to the event, which was attended by high-ranking members of the **Congress** party from other states.  The ceremony also included a gathering of religious leaders representing various faiths.

recent_articles.title: AITUC holds solidarity rally for Cuba in Thrissur - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **WFTU** deputy general secretary C. Sreekumar and other trade union leaders from the **AITUC** organized a solidarity rally in Thrissur, Kerala, to support the Cuban people.  The event saw strong participation from workers and trade union leaders who condemned U.S. sanctions on Cuba and expressed solidarity with the Cuban people.

recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Congress** lawmakers will meet on Saturday to elect **D K Shivakumar** as the party's new leader.  The meeting, overseen by **K C Venugopal** and **Randeep Singh Surjewala**, is expected to be followed by a swearing-in ceremony for **Shivakumar** as chief minister on Sunday or Monday.  **Siddaramaiah**, the outgoing chief minister, will propose **Shivakumar**'s candidacy and the Congress high command may authorize the selection of the new leader.

recent_articles.rephrased_article: A recent article criticizes the leadership of **Rahul Gandhi** and his sister, **Priyanka Gandhi**, within the **Congress Party**.  The author argues that despite the party's gains in the 2024 general elections, their lack of discipline, gravitas, and a clear vision for governance have hindered their progress. recent_articles.title: Shivakumar's astrologer predicts long stint for him as Karnataka CM
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Dwarakanath Guruji**, a prominent astrologer, has predicted that **D K Shivakumar**, the Kanakapura MLA and current Congress president in Karnataka, will hold the position of Chief Minister for an extended period. recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Rahul Gandhi**, **Atishi**, and other Opposition leaders criticized the **Narendra Modi** government's handling of the Common University Entrance Test (CUET-UG) 2026 after technical glitches caused disruptions at several examination centers across India. The agency revised the afternoon shift schedule and provided full duration to morning-session candidates.

recent_articles.title: Karnataka CM Oath: D K Shivakumar to take charge on June 3
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **D K Shivakumar**, the next chief minister of Karnataka, is set to take his oath on June 3 at the Glass House in Lok Bhavan. **G C Chandrashekhar**, the Congress state working president, confirmed the decision and stated that a simple ceremony reflecting work and service will be held.  **Chandrashekhar** also announced that bus arrangements for supporters were cancelled due to fuel crisis and traffic concerns.

recent_articles.title: Karnataka CM News: Why Siddaramaiah's dethroning might hit Rahul Gandhi the worst - Karnataka News | India Today
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Congress** high command brokered a transition formula in Karnataka, asking **Siddaramaiah** to resign as Chief Minister. This move has sparked protests and discontent among supporters of the veteran OBC leader, who is viewed as a strong mass leader in the state. The decision to remove **Siddaramaiah**, who had built the party organizationally over two decades, could potentially hurt **Rahul Gandhi's** political image, particularly his efforts to consolidate support for Dalits, minorities, and backward-class voters.  The move has also been criticized as unfair to a prominent leader within the party, raising concerns about potential backlash in future elections.

recent_articles.title: DK Shivakumar to become new Karnataka CM after being elected state CLP leader; oath ceremony on 3 June | Today News
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **DK Shivakumar**, the **Congress party's** Karnataka president, was elected as the leader of the Congress Legislature Party (CLP) on Saturday.  The CLP meeting at Vidhana Soudha saw outgoing Chief Minister Siddaramaiah propose Shivakumar's name for the post, which was unanimously accepted by the party members. The swearing-in ceremony is scheduled for June 3rd and will be held at the Glass House in Lok Bhavan, Bengaluru. Governor Thaawarchand Gehlot invited **Shivakumar** to take oath as Karnataka CM along with his team on June 3rd.

recent_articles.title: Abhishek Banerjee beaten up, TMC MP says ‘my head would have been split in two’; blames BJP for attack — Video | Today News
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Abhishek Banerjee**, TMC MP and nephew of **Mamata Banerjee**, was attacked by a mob in Sonarpur, West Bengal while visiting the family of a party worker killed during post-poll violence. recent_articles.title: Well-Known Educationists Arrested For Plotting Lawyer's Murder In Hyderabad | OdishaBytes
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Mujahid Alam Khan** and his father **Mahaboob Alam Khan**, owners of educational institutions in Hyderabad, have been arrested for the murder of senior advocate Khaja Moizuddin.  The investigation revealed that long-standing disputes between the families over Waqf properties management issues led to a grudge against the deceased. The accused conspired with associates Hassan Ali alias Chaous and Muneer to hire Kishan alias Pappu who carried out the plan, resulting in Moizuddin's death outside his home.  The police commissioner stated that the Khans believed their legal setbacks were due to the deceased’s involvement in several legal proceedings against them.
